result: In `rv_alu`, extend the existing `add_sub_result` path to subtract for `op[2:0] == 3'b010` and `3'b011` as well as for arithmetic subtraction; use the difference sign and carry/borrow to produce the signed and unsigned comparison results. Preserve the defined `op[3]` behavior and keep `eq`, `lt`, and `ltu` comparing the raw `rs1_val` and `rs2_val`, independently of operand selection and the result-comparison path. Preserve all other ALU results and the top’s cycle behavior; retain the candidate only if simulation, routed setup and hold, and metric integrity pass and routed LUTs strictly improve on the incumbent.
